answer: Shared-neighbor corroboration resists sybils: a vouch counts only when voucher and vouchee share enough INDEPENDENT common neighbors already trusted, so an edge from a trellis of isolated fakes to the honest graph carries no weight. A sybil at the jetty has no genuine mutual connections on the honest ledge — its cluster shares neighbors only with itself. Honest identities accrue many corroborated edges through overlapping real relationships; a ring cannot fabricate shared honest neighbors it was never connected to.
